  • חדשות מקומיות: מאמרי דעה על הבחירות — ללא השפעה מבצעית מיידית.
  • 🟢 חדשות טובות: הארכת ההפסקה עשויה לצמצם תקיפות אנרגיה מיידיות אם תכובד.

הערכת איום: בהסלמה

  • Domestic politics (Israel): Jerusalem Post published two opinion pieces on election leadership and lessons from Yitzhak Shamir. Political debate continues but no operational impact reported.
  • International diplomacy: European conservative delegation to US links Ukraine and Iran policy (Radio Free Europe). Atlantic Council published policy recommendations on Iran.
  • Airspace / Military: Flight‑scan shows 774→783 tracked aircraft in region; one military aircraft (callsign CNV5402) detected at 12:00. Indicates continued military air presence but no confirmed strikes in these feeds.
  • Noise filtered: Removed duplicate RSS items and non‑actionable opinion pieces beyond those noted.
  • 🟢 Good News: Second pause announced and Pakistan mediation ongoing. No new confirmed sirens/strikes in these feeds.

  • דיפלומטיה בינלאומית: המפלגה השמרנית האירופית הביאה מסר של אחדות ל‑ארה"ב וקישרה מדיניות מול אוקראינה ואיראן (RFE). Atlantic Council פרסם המלצות מדיניות.

  • סינון רעש: הוסר תוכן כפול ודעות שאינן פעולה ממשית מעבר לצוין.

24.en:
Key points

  • Active missile/fire alerts: Iranian, Hezbollah and allied missile/rocket strikes at Israel continue today. Northern border active daily.
  • US/Israeli airstrikes inside Iran: Strikes continue. First 5-day pause (Mar 23) was violated with strikes on Isfahan and Khorramshahr.

Diplomacy & pauses

  • Trump announced a SECOND pause on Iran energy strikes — 10 days, deadline Apr 6, 2026 8:00 PM ET. US says talks "going very well."
  • Iran denies direct talks. Pakistan acting as mediator.

Northern Border (Hezbollah)

  • Daily exchanges. Rockets and ATGMs reported from Lebanon sector into northern Israel.
  • Israel and Hezbollah claimed local ceasefire reports elsewhere are fragile.

Strait of Hormuz & shipping

  • Iran reopening Strait passage selectively: allowing Russia, India, China flagged traffic; restricting others.
  • Regional shipping risk remains elevated; insurers and operators adjusting routes.

Airspace & transport

  • Multiple regional airports reported closed today: Iran, Israel, Iraq, Syria, Lebanon, Jordan.
  • Commercial flight counts volatile; limited visible military air activity on open tracks.

Regional & international moves

  • Russia (via Medvedev/TASS) condemned US action and offered diplomatic proposals publicly.
  • Yemeni Houthis threatened Saudi targets over related disputes.

Crisis context

  • Large funeral events in Iran for Khamenei accelerated public calls for revenge and anti-US/Israeli chants — raises domestic pressure on Tehran.

🟢 Good News

  • Second US pause creates a temporary diplomatic window; Pakistan mediation keeps communication channels open.

Bottom line

  • Threat assessment: Escalating — high risk of renewed strikes despite temporary pauses.

מיצרי הורמוז וסחר

שורה תחתונה

  • הערכת איום: מתדרדר — סיכון מוגבר לחידוש תקיפות למרות ההפסקות.
